title: Slim and his band: the choker and Huey Smith
summary: Slim got along with the band; the band hid his guitar choker as a joke, and Slim and Huey Smith were roommates with nicknames.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Sometimes they'll take it off the top and they don't know how much they're actually paying. Right, right, right. That's what happened. How do you treat people in his band? Somebody told me he had sort of an ego problem. Did you find that?

I don't think so. I don't think he did. I mean, you know, he got along with the members of the band, alright, because they're always drinking. He was drinking and the member of the band was drinking, you know. So I don't think he, you might have, you see, he was a musician, he didn't know music. He only played by, yeah, you know, and he used a thing on his guitar called a choker. And if they took that choker he couldn't go on. Well sometimes they'd do it just to kick something, hide it, you know, almost time for him to go on. And then he'd come to me and say, hey, got my choker, so he got to get it, he got to get it. Well then I'd tell him, I'd threat the band, you're using a given choker, I ain't gonna pay you off, you know. So that's what happened, but he got along with them alright, I don't think he had no trouble with them. Him and Hewlett Smith was tight because they used to be room buddies, you know. Hewlett used to call him Poor Devil. Come on, answer the door for me.
Used to call him Poor Devil?

Yeah, Poor Devil. And he used to call Hewlett Death. Hewlett was so puny looking, you know, and he never would get up, when he'd go to bed at night from the, yeah, he never'd get the time to get up. He'd never get the time to go to the gig next year, he wouldn't get the heat or nothing, just to rent a bed all day. So Slim used to call him Death, and Hewlett called him Poor Devil.
